content:
Joining the ongoing AirPods 4 deal at nearly 25% off and a series of Apple Watch Ultra 3 models at nearly $100 off, this morning we spotted this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $449 off the new list price and the base model 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $250 off. Those deals also join iPhone 17 Pro Max units up to $449 off, the black iPhone 17 Pro/Max TechWoven case hitting the Amazon all-time low, Amazon’s wide-ranging Anker charging gear summer sale from $8.

Amazon offering Apple’s AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off

This 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $449 off the new list price right now at Amazon

While pricing on the latest MacBook Pro lineup has gone up, there are deals on just about every model at Amazon right now with at least $150 off the new list prices. That said, this 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 2TB is a giant $450 off the new list right now.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s Space Black 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB internal storage down at $2,549.99 shipped. The silver model has already jumped up in price, so there’s no telling how much longer the Space Black will remain this low.

This is now a $2,999 configuration sitting at just shy of $450 off the sticker price. The price has gone up, and we have seen this machine for less in the past, but we are also talking about a giant $450 in savings here as well.

No one likes price hikes, but if you are going to be landing a new M5 Pro machine this summer, or this year, there’s no way to know for sure what deal pricing is going to look like moving forward, and this one of the only machines left with a discount this sizable.

Again, Amazon is serving up prices well below the new MSRPs at Apple on just about all current-generation MacBook Pro models starting from $1,849, but not very many of them are sitting with a discount as deep as the featured model above.

Base model 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $250 off new list price at Amazon

Prices have gone up on the latest MacBook models, and that’s just something we have to deal with, but Amazon is at least offering some serious price relief today – the base model 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is nearly $250 off the new list price.

Amazon is now offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB internal storage capacity down at $1,249.99 shipped. This is the Sky Blue version of the most affordable 15-inch M5 you can buy.

Now carrying a regular price at $1,499, you’re looking at a solid $249 off the price at Apple here and the best deal we have tracked on any current-generation MacBook Air since the price hikes landed at Amazon.

As of the time of writing, this deal is only live on the Sky Blue model, but we are talking about a serious discount for anyone who might be considering a new M5 machine this summer. There’s no telling how deal pricing might shake out at retail in the coming months and one can only assume Amazon’s price on these MacBooks has gone up to some degree as well. The chances of seeing these machines back down at the prices we saw earlier this year anytime soon do not seem good right now.

Much of the same analysis applies to this giant $449 price drop we spotted this morning on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro as well.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 Ocean Band configs in Black and Natural Titanium nearly $100 off this week, more

We are getting another chance at some savings on the latest Apple Watch Ultra 3 this week. There were some notable deals during Prime Day a couple weeks ago, but if you missed out then, there are a number of configurations at nearly $100 off via Amazon right now.

Alongside some of the more pricey Milanese models, you will also find deals across various standard configurations including the one size fits just about everyone Ocean Band models in both Black and Natural Titanium:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)

While most of the other $99 price drops live this week are landing on large size band options, these Ocean Band models will fit just about any wrist while delivering options for both the Black and Natural case colors at the discounted rate.

Again, most of these models were lower during Prime Day, but that was the only time we have seen them down any lower than we have here today, and discounts have been generally hard to come by on Ultra 3 since release.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)

Scope them out right here with additional details below.

Nomad has now refreshed its sale section with a host of notable and, in some cases, quite rare Apple Watch band deals. You’ll still find some solid price drops on latest leather iPhone 17 cases in there, but it has now updated the deals with offers on its Rugged sport band, the leather Modern Band, and even some of its steel and titanium bracelet style straps.
